Voiceover Italiano 1.0.0 — initial release

- Instantly add natural-sounding AI Italian voiceovers to uploaded video files (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB).
- No editing experience required; just describe your request and receive a ready-to-download Italian-dubbed video in 1–2 minutes.
- Automatic backend connection, session handling, and video processing—no software to install.
- Simple prompts support (e.g., “add an Italian voiceover to this video”) for content creators and marketers.
- Supports batch uploads, timeline previews, and export in 1080p MP4 format.
- Includes error handling, credit management, and export status updates.
